DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更の用紙ですね。建物名の欄が途中までになっていますが、正式な名前はおわかりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is an address-change form. The building-name field stops partway; do you know the full official name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 契約書にはもっと長い名前があります。欄に入りきらなかったので、最後の言葉を省いて書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約書の正式名は長く、用紙に入らないため最後の言葉を省いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The contract has a longer name. It would not fit, so I omitted the final word.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the official contract name is long and you omitted the last word because it did not fit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 省略すると別の建物と紛らわしくなることがあります。この銀行では補記欄を使えますので、正式な建物名をそちらへお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Shortening it may cause confusion with another building. This bank has a supplementary field; write the full building name there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 補記欄に全文を書きます。部屋番号も名前の続きに書いたのですが、部屋番号だけの欄へ移したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 補記欄に正式名を全文書くと答え、建物名の続きに書いた部屋番号を専用欄へ移すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will write the whole name there. I put the room number after the name too; should I move it to the dedicated room field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will write the full name in the supplementary field and ask to move the room number to its own field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、部屋番号は専用の欄へお願いします。こちらは四〇二と読めますが、お間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, put the room number in its field. This reads402; is that correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四〇二ではなく四二〇です。自分の書き方がわかりにくかったので、三つの数字を離して書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号は四〇二ではなく四二〇だと訂正し、数字を離して読みやすく書き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is420, not402. My writing was unclear, so I will rewrite the three digits with spaces between them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct402 to420 and say you will rewrite the digits separately so they are legible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。契約書の記載と合わせて確認しましょう。お手元の確認書類にも、新しい住所は記載されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Let us compare it with the contract. Do your supporting documents also show the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、裏面に新住所が載っています。銀行からの通知も、手続が終わればこの四二〇号室へ送られるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認書類の裏面に新住所があると伝え、手続後の通知も四二〇号室へ届くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, on the back. Once the procedure is complete, will bank notices also go to this room420?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the new address is on the document's back and ask whether notices after the procedure go to room420. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 更新後の送付先はその住所になります。ただし、既に発送準備に入った通知は、旧住所へ届く場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The updated mailing address will be that address. However, notices already being prepared for dispatch may reach the old address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: すべて今日から切り替わるわけではないのですね。建物名の全文と四二〇号室で登録してください。旧住所へ送られた物が心配なら、別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 即時に全通知が切り替わるわけではないと確認し、正式建物名と四二〇号室で登録を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: So not everything switches from today. Please register the full building name and room420. If I am worried about items sent to the old address, I will ask separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm not all notices change immediately and request registration with the official building name and room420. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 正式な建物名と部屋番号を確認しました。こちらの確認書類と合わせて手続きを進めます。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed the full building name and room number. We will proceed together with these supporting documents. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの魚の加工品は冷蔵売場の商品です。お持ち帰りまで、どのくらいお時間がかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: This processed fish is sold refrigerated. How long until you take it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は買い物のあと島を観光して、明日帰ります。宿の部屋には冷蔵庫がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日観光して明日帰る予定で、宿の部屋に冷蔵庫がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will tour the island after shopping today and return home tomorrow. My accommodation room has no refrigerator.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will sightsee today, return tomorrow and have no fridge in your room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それでしたら、この冷蔵商品は保管が難しいですね。未開封で常温保存できる商品も、隣の棚にございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then storing this chilled product is difficult. On the next shelf are products that can be stored at room temperature unopened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の袋入りも同じ魚を使っていますか。原材料の最初の名前が小さくて読めないので、教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 隣の袋入りも同じ魚か尋ね、原材料の小さい文字を読んで教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does the bagged one next to it use the same fish? The first ingredient name is too small to read; please tell me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the nearby bag uses the same fish and request help reading the small ingredient text. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この袋には、あじと記載されています。魚の種類は同じですが、こちらは乾燥させた商品です。食感も冷蔵の品とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This bag says horse mackerel. The fish species is the same, but this product is dried. Its texture also differs from the chilled product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乾燥した物でも大丈夫です。常温保存とあれば、日中ずっと持ち歩いても問題ないという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乾燥品でもよいと伝え、常温保存なら一日持ち歩いても問題ない意味か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dried is fine. Does room-temperature storage mean there is no problem carrying it around all day?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept dried products and check whether room-temperature storage means all-day carrying is fine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示には直射日光と高温を避けるとも書かれています。炎天下の車内や日なたに置かず、涼しい場所で保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The label also says avoid direct sunlight and high temperatures. Keep it in a cool place, not in a hot parked car or sunlight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 観光中は日なたを歩く時間が長いので、今は買わず、明日の出発前に買いに来るほうがよさそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日なたを歩く時間が長いので今買わず、翌日の出発前に買う案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will walk in sunlight for a long time while sightseeing, so it seems better not to buy now but to come before leaving tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will buy before tomorrow's departure instead of now because of long walking in sunlight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ええ、そのほうが持ち歩く時間を短くできます。売場には開封後の保管方法も表示されていますので、そちらも見て選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, that shortens carrying time. The shelf also gives storage instructions after opening; check those when choosing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は冷蔵の商品を買うのをやめます。明日、袋入りの表示をもう一度見て、帰り道で日なたに放置しないように持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は冷蔵品を見送り、翌日に袋の表示を再確認し日なたに放置せず持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not buy the chilled product today. Tomorrow I will recheck the bag label and take it home without leaving it in sunlight on the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will skip chilled goods today, recheck the bag label tomorrow and avoid leaving it in sunlight on the journey home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。旅の予定に合う物を選んでくださいね。それでは、観光をお楽しみください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Choose something that suits your trip. Enjoy sightseeing, and thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧ですね。公園を一周されるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the map. Are you planning a full lap of the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 看板に三十分とありますが、一周全部を歩くと三十分なのですか。今日は十五分くらいで入口へ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 看板の三十分が一周の時間か確認し、今日は十五分程度で入口へ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sign says thirty minutes; is that for walking the whole lap? I want to return to the entrance in about fifteen minutes today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether thirty minutes means a full lap and say you want to return to the entrance in about fifteen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三十分は周回路全体の目安です。十五分でしたら、池の手前の東屋まで行って、同じ道を戻るほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thirty minutes is a guide for the whole loop. For fifteen, it is better to go to the gazebo before the pond and return the same way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ道を往復します。東屋まで行く途中で疲れたら、一周しないと入口に戻れない場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復路を選ぶと答え、東屋の手前で疲れた場合に一周せず戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will go out and back the same way. If tired before the gazebo, is there any point where I must complete the loop to get back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the return route and ask whether you can turn back without a full lap if tired before the gazebo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この道は途中でも引き返せます。橋を渡ると長い周回路に入るので、橋には進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can turn back partway on this path. Crossing the bridge enters the long loop, so do not head onto the bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋を渡らないようにします。道が二つに分かれる所では、池の絵の標識を選べばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋を渡らないと伝え、分岐では池の絵の標識を選べばよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not cross the bridge. At the fork, should I choose the sign with the pond picture?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not cross the bridge and check whether to choose the pond-picture sign at the fork. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、池の絵のほうです。展望台の矢印は坂道ですから、今日はそちらへ行かず、平らな道を使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, the pond picture. The lookout arrow is a slope, so avoid it today and use the level path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 平らな池の道を選びます。東屋が混んでいたら、その前にも座れる場所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 平らな池の道を選び、東屋が混んでいた場合に途中で座れる場所があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will choose the level pond path. If the gazebo is crowded, are there seats before it too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the level pond path and ask for seating on the way if the gazebo is crowded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中の大きな木の下にもベンチがあります。空いていればそこで休んで、無理に東屋まで行かなくても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is a bench under a large tree on the way. If free, rest there; you do not have to push on to the gazebo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 池の標識から平らな道を歩き、疲れたら木の下で休んで戻ります。橋や展望台へは進まず、来た道を入口まで戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 池標識から平らな道を進み、疲れたら木の下で休んで戻り、橋や展望台へ進まず入口へ引き返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will follow the pond sign on the level path, rest under the tree if tired and return. I will avoid the bridge and lookout and go back to the entrance the way I came.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the level pond path, resting under the tree and turning back if tired, without bridge or lookout, to the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ええ、入口はこの案内図の位置です。時間に余裕を持ってお戻りください。それでは、どうぞよいお散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, the entrance is here on the map. Leave enough time to return. Have a lovely walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り場へのご案内ですか。お荷物は持ったまま移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions to the boarding point? Will you keep your luggage with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このスーツケースが重くて、階段では下りられそうにありません。一階へ行きたいんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重いスーツケースを持ち階段では下りにくいため一階へ行きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This suitcase is heavy; I do not think I can take it down stairs. I want to get to the first floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the heavy suitcase makes stairs difficult and you want the first floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは二階です。階段の反対側にエレベーターがありますが、お一人で荷物を動かせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the second floor. There is a lift on the opposite side from the stairs. Can you move the luggage yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 平らな所なら動かせます。あの階段の手前で曲がると、エレベーターに着きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 平地では荷物を動かせると答え、階段手前が曲がる場所か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: On level ground, yes. Do I turn before those stairs to get to the lift?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can move it on level ground and ask whether to turn before the stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手前ではなく、案内板の横を通って突き当たりまで進みます。階段には近づかなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Not before them; pass beside the information board and go straight to the end. You do not need to approach the stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 曲がる場所を取り違えていました。案内板の横をまっすぐ進むんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲がる場所の誤解を認め、案内板横を直進する経路を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I misunderstood where to turn. So I go straight beside the information board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the wrong turning point and restate going straight beside the board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ええ。一階に下りると、扉を出た所に乗り場の案内があります。そこで乗り場番号を照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Down on the first floor, boarding information is outside the lift doors. Compare the boarding number there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗車案内はこれです。荷物を引きながらだと立ち止まりにくいので、ここで乗り場番号を確認しておけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を引いていると止まりにくい事情を述べ、移動前の乗り場番号確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here are my boarding instructions. It is hard to stop while pulling the luggage, so could we check the boarding number here first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain stopping while pulling luggage is difficult and ask to check the boarding number before moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちの乗車案内には二番とありますね。一階でも行き先の表示を確かめてからお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your instructions say number2. On the first floor, check the destination sign too before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二番というメモを乗車案内に挟みます。まず突き当たりのエレベーターへ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二番のメモを乗車案内に挟み、突き当たりのエレベーターへ向かうと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put a note saying2 into the boarding instructions. First I will head to the lift at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to tuck a number2 note in the instructions and go to the lift at the end. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら案内を出し直さずに済みますね。荷物が扉に挟まれないよう気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then you need not take the instructions out again. Take care not to trap luggage in the doors. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの書類は、転入のご相談でしょうか。それとも住所の記載を直すご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are these documents for advice about moving in, or correcting an address entry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 転入の相談です。先週引っ越して、この用紙を書いたのですが、部屋番号を間違えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先週転居して転入相談に来たことと、用紙の部屋番号を誤記したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Moving in. I moved last week and filled this form, but wrote the wrong room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you moved last week and came for moving-in advice, and the form has a wrong room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 誤った番号のまま出す前に分かってよかったです。正しい番号を確かめられるメモなどはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Good that you noticed before submitting the wrong number. Do you have a note or something confirming the right one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引っ越しのときのメモには三〇二とあります。用紙には三〇一と書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メモの正しい番号三〇二と用紙の誤った番号三〇一を区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My moving note says302. I wrote301 on the form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish correct302 in the note from wrong301 on the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二つが違うのですね。住所の根拠を担当窓口でも確認しますので、メモは書類と一緒に見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Those two differ, understood. The responsible counter will also check evidence of the address, so show the note with the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で二重線を引いて直してよいですか。それとも新しい用紙に書き直しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二重線で訂正してよいか、新しい用紙に書き直すかを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I correct it with a double line myself, or should I rewrite a new form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to correct with a double line or fill a new form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この用紙の訂正方法は担当に確かめてからにしましょう。まだ手を加えず、誤った欄が分かるようにしておけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the correction method with the staff first. Leave it unchanged for now and make the incorrect field identifiable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、部屋番号の欄を付箋で示します。在留カードも一緒に出せるようにしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訂正欄を付箋で示し、在留カードも一緒に提示できるよう準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will mark the room-number field with a sticky note. I will prepare my residence card to show with it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will mark the field with a sticky note and prepare the residence card together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご本人の状況と持参されたものを確認した上で、不足や次の手続きを担当がご案内します。ほかに伝えておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After checking your circumstances and what you brought, the staff will explain anything missing and next steps. Anything else to tell us?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 転入と一緒に保険の相談先も聞きたいので、その用件も受付に添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転入に加えて保険の相談先も知りたいので、受付の用件に加えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Along with moving in, I want to ask where to discuss insurance, so please add that to the reception purpose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to add an insurance-consultation destination to the moving-in purpose at reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 部屋番号の訂正方法と保険の相談先ですね。二つとも担当へ引き継ぎます。窓口へお進みください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: The correction method and where to ask about insurance. I will pass both on. Please go to the counter. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再診予約の変更ですね。現在の予約票を拝見してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Changing a follow-up appointment, understood. May I see your current appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約票はこちらです。火曜の午前が予約日ですが、勤務が変わって来られなくなりました。同じ週の午後を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 火曜午前の再診に勤務都合で来られず、同じ週の午後へ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. It is Tuesday morning, but my work changed and I cannot come. I would like an afternoon in the same week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain work prevents Tuesday-morning follow-up and ask for an afternoon that week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前を票と照合できました。予定を確認する前に、前回から体調に変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I have matched your name to the slip. Before checking the schedule, has your condition changed since last time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分で気づいた変化はありません。担当の先生が変わるなら、予約を決める前に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 気づいた体調変化はないと答え、担当医が変わる場合は決定前に知らせてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have noticed no changes. If the doctor would change, please tell me before deciding the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say no changes noticed and ask to be told before deciding if the doctor changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約担当に確認したところ、同じ先生では木曜の午後に一枠あります。今の火曜の予約をその枠へ変更しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I checked with scheduling; there is one Thursday-afternoon slot with the same doctor. Would you like to change Tuesday to it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木曜なら休みを調整できます。その枠は午後の何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 木曜なら休みを調整できると述べ、午後の具体的な時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can arrange time off Thursday. What time in the afternoon is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say Thursday leave can be arranged and ask the specific afternoon time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 午後二時です。ご希望が確定するまでは、変更の登録を進めずにいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Two in the afternoon. We will not register a change until your choice is final.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 木曜の午後二時でお願いします。古い予約票を見て間違えないよう、新しい票をいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 木曜午後二時への変更を依頼し、旧票との取り違えを防ぐ新しい予約票を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thursday at two, please. Could I have a new slip so I do not mistakenly follow the old one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request Thursday14:00 and a new slip to avoid confusing the old one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 木曜の午後二時へ変更しました。こちらが新しい予約票です。以前の票と区別して保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Changed to Thursday14:00. Here is the new slip. Keep it distinct from the old one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手帳も木曜二時に直しました。持ち物の案内は、この新しい票の裏面を見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手帳を木曜二時に直したと伝え、新しい票の裏面が持ち物案内か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I corrected my diary to Thursday at two too. Are the instructions on what to bring on the back of this new slip?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say your diary is corrected to Thursday14:00 and check whether the new slip's back lists what to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、裏面の案内をご覧ください。気になる記載は予約窓口へお尋ねくださいね。どうぞお大事に。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, read the back. Ask the appointment counter about any wording that concerns you. Take care of yourself. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないのですね。最後に見たときのことから伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle is missing. Let us start with when you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の夜、駐輪場に停めました。今朝戻ったらなくて、盗まれたのかと心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨夜停めた自転車が今朝見当たらず、盗難かと心配していることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I parked it last night. It was gone when I returned this morning, and I am worried about theft.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the bicycle parked last night was missing this morning and you fear theft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ原因は決めずに状況を整理しましょう。停めた入口と、今朝探した入口は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us organize the situation without deciding the cause yet. Are the entrance where you parked and where you looked this morning the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜は東側から入りましたが、今朝は西側からでした。入口が二つあるとは知りませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 停めたときは東入口、今朝探したのは西入口で、二つの入口を知らなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I entered from the east at night and west this morning. I did not know there were two entrances.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain parking via east, looking via west this morning and not knowing two entrances existed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を取り違えた可能性もありますね。車体を識別できる特徴や、防犯登録の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may have confused the location. Do you have identifying features or registration documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紺色の自転車で、後ろのかごに白いひもを結んであります。登録の控えも持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紺色の車体と後ろかごの白いひもを伝え、防犯登録の控えを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is navy blue, with a white cord tied to the rear basket. I have the registration copy too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the navy bicycle and white rear-basket cord and show the registration copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その控えと特徴を記録します。東側を確かめる際にも役立ちますので、最後の位置も絞れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record the copy and features. To help check the east side, can you narrow the last location too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 東の入口を入ってすぐの屋根の下です。鍵をかけたかどうかは、今ははっきり思い出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 東入口すぐの屋根の下と場所を絞り、施錠したかは思い出せないと区別して答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Under the roof just inside the east entrance. I cannot clearly remember whether I locked it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify under the roof just inside east, separately saying locking is not remembered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不明な点は不明のままで結構です。まず東側と、管理者が把握している移動の有無を確かめ、結果をお知らせいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Unknown points can remain unknown. First check east and whether the manager knows of any relocation, then tell us the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東側の屋根の下を確かめてから管理者に聞きます。見つからなければ、確認した結果を添えてこちらに連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 東側を探して管理者に移動の有無を聞き、未発見なら結果を警察窓口へ連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check under the east roof and ask the manager. If not found, I will contact you with what I checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will search east, ask the manager about relocation and report results to police if not found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で確認したことを伺い、必要な届け出についてご案内します。お気をつけて。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will hear what you checked in that order and explain any necessary report. Take care. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類の発送ですね。提出先から送付方法の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending documents. Does the recipient specify a shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内には「送った記録を残すこと」とだけあります。追跡できれば、その条件を満たすのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送った記録を残すという指定を示し、追跡だけで条件を満たすか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The instructions only say keep a record of sending. Does tracking satisfy that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the requirement to keep a sending record and ask whether tracking alone meets it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追跡で確認できる内容と、提出先が証明として求める内容は同じとは限りません。受付した記録か、受け取った記録か、書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: What tracking confirms may differ from the proof the recipient needs. Does it say a record of acceptance or of receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこまでは書かれていません。発送した日が分かればよいのか、相手の受領まで必要なのか、聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内では不明と答え、発送日か相手の受領記録かを提出先に聞き直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It does not say that far. I will ask whether a shipping date is enough or they need the recipient's receipt record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say instructions are unclear and you will ask whether sending-date or recipient-receipt proof is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それが分かれば、取扱いの条件と照らして選べます。提出するのは原本ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once known, you can compare with service conditions. Are you sending an original?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 原本を一通送ります。手元用のコピーを取ってから封をするつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送るのは原本一通で、封をする前に手元用コピーを取る予定だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: One original. I plan to make a copy for myself before sealing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain one original is being sent and you will copy it for yourself before sealing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封をする前に提出先の指定内容も見直せますね。宛先の案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can review the recipient's requirements before sealing too. Do you have the address instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ただ、案内には会社名と部署名があり、封筒には会社名だけを書きました。部署も足しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内には部署名もあるが封筒は会社名だけなので部署を追記すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. They include company and department names, but I wrote only the company on the envelope. I will add the department.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the instructions include a department missing from the envelope and you will add it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当部署まで記したものを、案内と見比べてください。発送方法は、先ほどの記録の条件が分かってから決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Compare the address including the department with the instructions. Decide shipping after learning the record requirement we discussed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に提出先へ電話します。必要な記録をメモして、コピーと宛先を整えてから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先へ電話し、必要な記録をメモしてコピーと宛先を整えて戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will phone the recipient first. I will note the necessary record, prepare the copy and address, then return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to call the recipient, note required proof and return after preparing copy and address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 戻られたら、そのメモをもとに方法をご相談ください。いったん書類をお返しします。それでは、またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: When back, discuss the method using that note. I will return the documents for now. Please come again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座についてのご相談ですね。どのようにお使いになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an account question. How do you plan to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい勤務先の給与受取用です。この二枚を持ってきました。会社に渡す口座情報がまだなく、申込みの準備をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新勤務先の給与受取用口座が必要で、まだ口座情報はなく申込準備をしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: For salary from a new employer. I brought these two documents. I have no account details to give the company yet and want to prepare an application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you need a salary account for a new employer, have no details yet and want application preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの資料を拝見すると、勤務先のメモはカタカナで、本人の資料はアルファベットですね。会社から表記の指定はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your employer's note is in katakana, while your personal document uses the alphabet. Did the company specify a name format?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 振込に使う名前までは聞いていませんでした。この二つの表記が違うことも会社へ伝えるべきですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 振込名義の指定は未確認と答え、カタカナとアルファベットの違いを勤務先へ伝えるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not ask the transfer name. Should I tell the company these two forms differ too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the transfer-name requirement is unchecked and ask whether to report the katakana/alphabet difference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 給与の振込担当には確認しておくとよいでしょう。こちらでの本人確認や申込みとは、別の確認になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is best to check with payroll. This is separate from our identification and application checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人確認用の資料は持参しました。先に会社の返事を待たず、今日ここで相談できる範囲を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認用資料は持参したと述べ、会社の返答前でも本日相談できる範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought identification documents. Please tell me what we can discuss today without waiting for the company's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you brought identification and ask what can be discussed before the company replies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な書類や確認事項の案内はできます。ただし、書類の確認や審査があるので、本日中の開設はお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can explain needed documents and checks. However, document verification and screening mean we cannot promise opening today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 勤務先には口座ができたとは言わず、申込準備中だと伝えます。不足があれば項目ごとに控えさせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先には開設済みでなく準備中と伝え、不足する項目を一つずつ控えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not tell work the account is open; I will say I am preparing to apply. Let me note each missing item if any.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell work preparation is underway, not account opened, and ask to note missing items one by one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、持参されたものと追加確認が必要なものを分けて整理します。会社に尋ねる内容も、別の欄へ書いておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let us separate what you brought from items needing further checks. Write questions for the company in another field too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行に確認する書類と、会社に聞く振込名義を二つの欄に分けました。返答をそろえて、改めて申込みを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行の書類確認と会社の振込名義を別欄に整理し、返答をそろえて申込相談に戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I separated bank-document checks and the company's transfer-name question into two fields. I will gather replies and discuss applying again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize bank-document and company-name checks separately and say you will return with replies to discuss applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お持ちの資料は全てお返しします。記載で迷う点は次回もお尋ねください。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will return all your documents. Ask again next time about wording you are unsure of. Thank you for consulting today. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札をご覧になっていますね。どちらの袋をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at price labels. Which bag are you seeking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二キロを手に取ったのですが、下の値札には一キロとあります。この袋の札は別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手にした二キロ袋と目の前の一キロ値札が違うので、対応する札を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I picked up two kilograms, but the label below says one kilogram. Is this bag's label elsewhere?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the right label because your two-kilogram bag differs from the one-kilogram label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。一キロの札は隣の商品です。二キロはこちらの品名と容量の札に対応しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, one kilogram is the neighbouring product. Two kilograms corresponds to this name-and-size label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋の色が似ていて見間違えました。この札の横の割引表示も、二キロ用でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋の色が似て読み違えたと説明し、横の割引も二キロが対象か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bag colours look alike, so I misread. Is the discount beside this label for two kilograms too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain similar bag colours caused misreading and ask whether the adjacent discount covers two kilograms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象は二キロですが、この表示にはクーポンの提示が必要と書かれています。クーポンはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Two kilograms is eligible, but this says a coupon must be shown. Do you have one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会員登録はしていますが、クーポンは持っていません。会員というだけでは使えないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会員だがクーポンは持たないと伝え、会員だけでは割引を使えないことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am registered as a member but have no coupon. Membership alone does not qualify, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are a member without a coupon and confirm membership alone does not enable the discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この表示の割引はクーポンの条件付きです。提示しない場合に比べる価格は、こちらの通常価格になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This discount requires a coupon. Without presenting one, compare using this regular price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は通常価格で比べます。一人暮らしなので、一キロと二キロのどちらを食べ切れるかも考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通常価格で比較し、一人で食べ切れる一キロか二キロかを考えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will compare regular prices today. I live alone, so I also want to consider whether I can finish one or two kilograms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare regular prices and consider whether one person can finish one or two kilograms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 価格の数字だけでなく袋の量も選ぶ基準ですね。一キロの袋は隣の白い札の前にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Quantity matters too, not just price numbers. The one-kilogram bag is beside it in front of the white label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回は一キロに替えます。こちらの袋と白い札の品名・容量が一致しているか、最後に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回は一キロに替えると決め、袋と白い札の品名・容量の最終照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will switch to one kilogram this time. Could you finally check that this bag and the white label's name and size match?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose one kilogram and request a final name-and-size comparison with the white label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じ品名の一キロで合っています。その袋でお会計へお進みください。お買い物をお楽しみください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The name matches and it is one kilogram. Take that bag to checkout. Enjoy shopping. Goodbye for now.
